subject: Request: legal & dealdesk signoff for extended POC runway + credit uplift
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: legal & dealdesk signoff for extended POC runway + credit uplift

Team —

Summary: Helios Health (connected via Samantha) is asking for a non-standard one-time extension of their POC from 30 -> 90 days and an uplift of complimentary credits to cover a spike in inference usage during their integration tests. They are mid-evaluation and will commit to a paid pilot if we can give runway to finish two benchmarks. This is outside our PLG policy (standard: single 30-day extension, up to $3k credits).

Why this matters: Helios is a targeted vertical prospect (healthcare analytics) with explicit security requirements; they referenced SOC2 and custom inference patterns that mimic our largest financial deals. Their expected ARR if they convert is $420k ARR (sales forecast attached). The quick wins we need to validate are: latency under 120ms p95 for 1k qps, and embedding accuracy on the clinical dataset.

Ask (single step approval request):
- One-time extension: +60 days (total 90-day POC)
- One-time complimentary credit uplift: $12,000 (to cover peak inference over the extended window)

Conditions I recommend (to limit precedent):
- Legal amendment signed (attached proposed-amendment.docx)
- Procurement contact on record and payment terms agreed for eventual pilot convert
- Metrics milestone: two benchmark reports by day 45 and day 75

Attachments: Helios_POC_metrics.pdf (current usage/forecast), proposed-amendment.docx, POC_usage_snapshot.csv

I am asking for quick authorization so I can send Samantha the amendment and update procurement. If you want a call with the Helios engineering lead before signoff I can schedule today.

Thanks,
Chloe
Chloe Martin | Director, Strategic Sales | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0129

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: legal & dealdesk signoff for extended POC runway + credit uplift

Chloe —

Thanks for the concise ask. A couple clarifying questions before I can greenlight from dealdesk:
- Is the $12k covering estimated peak only or baseline + peak? Please call out the bucket.
- Will Helios agree to engineered rollbacks (e.g., model size cap) if usage exceeds forecast?
- Who will own the conversion milestone (Sales or CS) once benchmarks are complete?

Also, we'll need procurement confirmation in writing. Can you loop proof of purchase intent or an MSA signature timeline? If we get procurement confirmation and Legal signs the amendment, I can approve a one-off uplift under the following guardrails: 1) credits escrowed and expire at day 95 if not consumed, 2) Deal desk to track incremental unit economics in the HubSpot deal.

If Chloe, you can address the three bullets here I can push to Aditya for fast exec approval.

- Marissa
Marissa Cole | Sr. Deal Desk Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 12:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: legal & dealdesk signoff for extended POC runway + credit uplift

Marissa / Chloe —

I reviewed the note and attachments. Given the forecasted ARR and strategic fit, I approve a one-time exception with the following explicit conditions:

1) Approve +60 day extension (total 90 days) and $12,000 credit uplift.
2) Legal to sign the attached amendment before credits are applied.
3) Procurement must confirm intent to purchase and an estimated PO value (email from procurement acceptable).
4) Credits will be time-limited (expire at day 95) and will not be refundable.

Marissa — please capture the approval in the deal record (DL-2027-0943) and add a Deal Desk note referencing this exec exception. Mina — please prioritize amendment review; we need a redline back within 24 hours. Chloe — proceed to Samantha with conditional language (legal + procurement).

Aditya
Aditya Rao | Chief Revenue Officer | Redwood Inference

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@helioshealth.com>, procurement@helioshealth.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: legal & dealdesk signoff for extended POC runway + credit uplift

Samantha —

Great to connect this morning. Following internal review, were able to make a one-time exception: Redwood will approve a 60-day extension (90-day total POC) and provide a $12,000 complimentary credit uplift under the conditions listed below. This is an exception to our standard PLG limits.

Conditions (summary):
- Redwood approval is conditional on a signed amendment (Ive attached the proposed amendment; Legal (Mina) will send a redline within 24 hours).
- Procurement confirmation email accepting the payment timeline / intent to purchase is required before credits are applied.
- Credits expire 5 days after the extended window (day 95) and are non-refundable.
- Benchmarks: two verified reports due day 45 and day 75. Failure to deliver these nullifies future exceptions.

Next steps for Helios:
1) Please review the attached amendment and confirm procurement email contact who will approve a PO (procurement@helioshealth.com is fine).
2) I will send the DocuSign link for the amendment once Legal confirms redline is acceptable.
3) Marissa will update the HubSpot deal with the exec exception and credit tracking.

We appreciate the pace on this — Ill share the DocuSign link here when ready.

Best,
Chloe
Chloe Martin | Director, Strategic Sales | Redwood Inference
Email: chloe.martin@redwood.ai | Mobile: +1 415-555-0129
